gloss: place one returns to; return destination

definitions.gloss: place where one is going back to; return destination
definitions.explanation: The address or location someone is heading home to — used in shipping forms, travel arrangements, and questions about where someone is staying. Compound of {帰|かえ}る (to return) + {先|さき} (destination).

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り{先|さき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰|かえ}り{先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the return address on the form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}いて→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧、⟦いつの{間|ま}にか→いつの間にか：01812_itsunomanika⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰|かえ}り{先|さき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曖昧|あいまい}→曖昧：08051_aimai⟧になってきた。
examples.english: With the business trip dragging on, before I knew it I'd become unsure where 'home' even was anymore.

notes:
⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ here means 'destination', as in ⟦{行|い}き{先|さき}→行き先：16779_ikisaki⟧ (where one is going) or ⟦{勤|つと}め{先|さき}→勤め先：21550_tsutomesaki⟧ (place of employment). Found most often on forms, in administrative contexts, and in questions about where a traveler is staying.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{先|さき}→行き先：16779_ikisaki⟧: destination — where one is going (one-way sense)
- {帰宅先|きたくさき}: place of return; place to go home to — more formal compound used in official records
- ⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧: one's parents' home — common informal answer to 'where will you spend the holidays?'
